quote: The biggest lesson that can be read from 70 years of AI research is that general methods that leverage computation are ultimately the most effective, and by a large margin.
author: Richard Sutton

quote: The fundamental problem of communication is that of reproducing at one point either exactly or approximately a message selected at another point.
author: Claude Shannon

quote: Simplicity is a great virtue but it requires hard work to achieve it and education to appreciate it. And to make matters worse: complexity sells better.
author: Edsger W. Dijkstra

quote: We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see plenty there that needs to be done.
author: Alan Turing

quote: Attention, taken to its highest degree, is the same thing as prayer. It presupposes faith and love. Absolutely unmixed attention is prayer.
author: Simone Weil

quote: A change in perspective is worth 80 IQ points.
author: Alan Kay
